```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(crosstalk)
library(plotly)

# 1. Leemos los datos
datos <- read_csv("../datos/procesados/dataset_sube.csv")

# 2. Preparamos días, fecha, total diario y promedio móvil de 7 días
dias <- c("Lunes", "Martes", "Miércoles", "Jueves", "Viernes", "Sábado", "Domingo")

datos <- datos %>%
  mutate(
    dia_semana_lbl = factor(dias[dia_semana + 1], levels = dias),
    fecha = seq.Date(from = as.Date("2020-01-01"), by = "day", length.out = n()),
    total_viajes = colectivo_amba + tren_amba + subte_amba,
    # Promedio móvil de 7 días para suavizar las líneas igual al mockup
    col_ma7 = as.numeric(stats::filter(colectivo_amba, rep(1/7, 7), sides = 1)),
    tren_ma7 = as.numeric(stats::filter(tren_amba, rep(1/7, 7), sides = 1)),
    subte_ma7 = as.numeric(stats::filter(subte_amba, rep(1/7, 7), sides = 1))
  )

# 3. Objeto compartido para que los filtros controlen ambos gráficos
sd <- SharedData$new(datos)
```

# Resumen

## Row {height="130px"}

### Column {width=60%}


```{r}
#| title: "Rango de fechas"
filter_slider(
  id = "filtro_fecha",
  label = NULL,
  sharedData = sd,
  column = ~fecha,
  step = 1,
  width = "92%",
  timeFormat = "%d/%m/%Y",
  dragRange = TRUE
)
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Días de la semana"
filter_select(
  id = "filtro_dia",
  label = NULL,
  sharedData = sd,
  group = ~dia_semana_lbl,
  multiple = TRUE
)
```

## Row {height="145px"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total de viajes"
list(
  icon = "people-fill",
  color = "primary",
  value = label_number(scale = 1e-9, suffix = " B", accuracy = 0.01)(sum(datos$colectivo_amba + datos$tren_amba + datos$subte_amba, na.rm = TRUE))
)
```

```{r}

)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
```

## Row {height="65%"}

### Column {width=55%}

```{r}
#| title: "El colectivo concentra la mayoría de los viajes (promedio móvil de 7 días)"
plot_ly(sd, x = ~fecha) %>%
  add_lines(y = ~col_ma7, name = "Colectivo", line = list(color = "#0d6efd", width = 2.5)) %>%
  add_lines(y = ~tren_ma7, name = "Tren", line = list(color = "#d97706", width = 2)) %>%
  add_lines(y = ~subte_ma7, name = "Subte", line = list(color = "#7c3aed", width = 2)) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "", showgrid = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "", 
      tickvals = c(0, 1e6, 2e6, 3e6),
      ticktext = c("0", "1 M", "2 M", "3 M"),
      gridcolor = "#f1f5f9"
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.3, y = -0.15),
    shapes = list(
      list(
        type = "rect",
        x0 = "2020-03-20", x1 = "2020-06-30",
        y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper",
        fillcolor = "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2)",
        line = list(width = 0)
      )
    ),
annotations = list(
      list(
        x = "2020-05-10", y = 1500000,
        text = "Cuarentena 2020",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        xanchor = "left",
        font = list(size = 11, color = "#64748b")
      )
    ),
    margin = list(t = 10, b = 40)
  ) %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

### Column {width=45%}

```{r}
#| title: "Los días hábiles concentran más viajes (línea punteada = promedio)"
plot_ly(
  sd, 
  x = ~dia_semana_lbl, 
  y = ~total_viajes,
  type = "box",
  boxmean = TRUE, # Dibuja automáticamente la línea punteada del promedio
  fillcolor = "#cbd5e1",
  line = list(color = "#334155", width = 1.5),
  marker = list(opacity = 0), # Oculta puntos sueltos para que quede limpio como el mockup
  showlegend = FALSE
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Millones de viajes por día (todos los modos)", showgrid = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "",
      tickvals = c(0, 1e6, 2e6, 3e6, 4e6, 5e6),
      ticktext = c("0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
      gridcolor = "#f1f5f9"
    ),
    margin = list(t = 10, b = 40)
  ) %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```
